sloka: अन्वास्य पश्चिमाम् संध्याम् तत्र वासम् अकल्पयत् ।सुतीक्ष्णस्य आश्रमे रम्ये सीतया लक्ष्मनेन च ॥३-७-२३॥
transliteration: anvāsya paścimām saṁdhyām tatra vāsam akalpayat ।sutīkṣṇasya āśrame ramye sītayā lakṣmanena ca ॥3-7-23॥

translations.english: Rama stopped with this. And then the evening drew to a close. Offering his evening oblation, he arranged for his stay along with Sita and Lakshmana in the delightful hermitage of Sutikshna.
